zh.title: 羅馬尼亞F-16戰機向黑海漂流海面無人機開火並將其擊毀
zh.summary: 羅馬尼亞空軍F-16戰機於黑海向一艘漂流的海面無人機開火並成功將其摧毀。
body: 根據 AeroTime 報導，羅馬尼亞國防部表示，其空軍兩架 F-16 戰機於 2026 年 8 月 20 日被派往應對一架在其專屬經濟區內漂流的小型海面無人機。其中一架戰機使用機載航炮向該目標開火並成功命中。
該無人機最初是在 Neptun Alpha 生產平台附近被發現。羅馬尼亞臨時國防部長 Radu Miruță 隨後證實，在與總統協調後，決定摧毀該無人機以保護平台上數百名員工與關鍵基礎設施的安全。此外，當天早些時候，另一架無人機闖入羅馬尼亞領空，並在西班牙 F-18 戰機緊急起飛後墜毀。

en.title: Romanian F-16 Fires Cannon and Destroys Sea Drone Near Black Sea Gas Platform
en.summary: Romanian F-16 fighters intercepted and safely destroyed a drifting maritime drone near a Black Sea gas platform.
body: According to AeroTime, the Romanian Ministry of National Defense announced that two Romanian Air Force F-16 fighters were dispatched on August 20, 2026, to intercept a small maritime drone drifting within the country's exclusive economic zone. One of the aircraft fired its onboard gun and successfully hit the target.

The drone was spotted near the Neptun Alpha gas production platform. Interim Defense Minister Radu Miruță confirmed that the drone was safely destroyed to protect hundreds of workers and secure critical infrastructure. Separately, earlier that day, another drone entered Romanian airspace and crashed near Grindu after Spanish Air and Space Force F-18s were scrambled.

zh.title: IATA宣布2026貨運專家會議將於匈牙利布達佩斯舉行
zh.summary: 國際航空運輸協會宣布2026年貨運專家會議9月於匈牙利布達佩斯舉行
body: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）宣布，2026年IATA貨運專家會議（CEC）將於2026年9月23日至24日在匈牙利布達佩斯舉行。本次會議主題為「從專業到執行」，旨在透過全球標準、技術與資料應用，著重改善日常航空貨運營運的實務方法。
本次會議將設立三大專業領域，包括數位貨運、安全與安保，以及醫藥與貨運營運。會議議題涵蓋推進「ONE Record」資料標準採用、應對危險品與未申報鋰電池的安全風險，以及透過智慧合規與即時資料加強醫藥冷鏈營運。
IATA全球貨運負責人布倫丹·沙利文（Brendan Sullivan）表示，高效營運對於每日仰賴可靠交付的航空貨運客戶至關重要，該會議將凝聚產業專家共同應對營運挑戰。

en.title: IATA to Hold 2026 Cargo Experts Conference in Budapest
en.summary: IATA will host the 2026 Cargo Experts Conference in Budapest, focusing on air cargo operational standards.
body: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) announced that the 2026 IATA Cargo Experts Conference will take place in Budapest, Hungary, on September 23–24, 2026. Held under the theme "From Expertise to Execution," the event will focus on practical methods to enhance daily air cargo operations through global standards, technology, and data.

The conference will feature three specialized tracks covering digital cargo, safety and security, and pharmaceutical operations. Key discussion topics include advancing the adoption of IATA's ONE Record data standard, addressing risks associated with dangerous goods and undeclared lithium batteries, and strengthening cold-chain ground handling through real-time data compliance.

Brendan Sullivan, IATA's Global Head of Cargo, stated that effective operations are essential for businesses whose customers depend on reliable daily deliveries. The conference aims to bring industry experts together to address common operational challenges.

zh.title: 美國交通部撥款近6.15億美元 挹注238項全美機場改善計畫
zh.summary: 美國交通部撥款近6.15億美元，資助全美238項機場基礎設施改善專案。
body: 美國交通部部長蕭恩·達菲（Sean P. Duffy）宣布，將透過「機場改善計畫」（Airport Improvement Program，簡稱AIP）撥款近6.15億美元，資助全美42個州及兩個領地共238項補助款。該項大規模資金投入旨在升級與強化全美各地機場的關鍵基礎設施，改善跑道與滑行道狀況，並優化航廈乘客設施與飛行區安全設備。

依據美國聯邦航空管理局（FAA）發布的撥款計畫細節，重點補助項目涵蓋各類規模的機場設施需求。其中，德克薩斯州的米德蘭國際空天港（MAF；Midland International Air & Space Port）獲得2150萬美元用於跑道整修工程；阿拉斯加州諾阿塔克（Noatak）獲得1950萬美元用於興建一座新機場；加利福尼亞州的聖地牙哥國際機場（SAN；San Diego International Airport）則獲得1530萬美元用於降噪改善計畫。

其他獲得資助的代表性機場項目還包括：印第安納州的蓋瑞/芝加哥國際機場（GYY；Gary/Chicago International Airport）獲撥830萬美元興建新合約管制塔台；維吉尼亞州的林奇堡區域機場（LYH；Lynchburg Regional Airport）獲撥800萬美元興建新航廈；北卡羅來納州的威爾明頓國際機場（ILM；Wilmington International Airport）獲撥630萬美元用於跑道延伸；加利福尼亞州的沙加緬度國際機場（SMF；Sacramento International Airport）獲撥240萬美元用於更新旅客登機橋。
根據交通部說明，機場可將機場改善計畫補助金運用於跑道、滑行道、標誌、照明、標線及其他與安全相關的建設。交通部長達菲指出，升級機場基礎設施是打造高效與安全交通體系的一環；聯邦航空管理局局長布萊恩·貝德福德（Bryan Bedford）亦表示，在全美航空出行需求持續增長之際優先推動這些資助，將有助於提升整體旅客出行體驗。

en.title: USDOT Announces $615 Million in AIP Grants for 238 Airport Projects Across US
en.summary: USDOT announced nearly $615 million in grants for 238 airport infrastructure projects across the United States.
body: U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean P. Duffy announced a $615 million investment to fund 238 grants through the Airport Improvement Program across 42 states and two territories. The federal funding initiative from the U.S. Department of Transportation is designed to modernize and reinforce infrastructure at airports nationwide, supporting critical airfield safety upgrades, runway and taxiway rehabilitation, and terminal facility improvements for passengers.

Under the announced grant distribution, federal funding targets specific infrastructure and operational needs at airports of varying sizes nationwide. Key major project allocations include $21.5 million awarded to Midland International Air & Space Port (MAF) in Texas for runway rehabilitation, $19.5 million allocated to construct a new airport in Noatak, Alaska, and $15.3 million provided to San Diego International Airport (SAN) for noise mitigation projects.

Additional high-priority grant awards detailed by the agency include $8.3 million to Gary/Chicago International Airport (GYY) in Indiana to construct a new contract tower and $8 million to Lynchburg Regional Airport (LYH) in Virginia for a new terminal facility. Furthermore, Wilmington International Airport (ILM) in North Carolina receives $6.3 million for runway extension, while Sacramento International Airport (SMF) in California is awarded $2.4 million for new passenger boarding bridges.

According to the agency, airports can utilize Airport Improvement Program funding for infrastructure projects including runways, taxiways, signage, lighting, markings, and other safety-related airfield needs. Transportation Secretary Duffy emphasized that upgrading airport infrastructure helps deliver a safer and smoother travel experience, while Federal Aviation Administration Administrator Bryan Bedford stated that prioritizing these grants supports growing travel volumes and transforms the overall passenger journey.
